title: Map-dim carousel announce (Springs /location announce)
source: springs.estate l-map / landingMapScroll + /location ('The Center of Your Life'). Engine = library/components/map-dim-carousel-announce (proven, owns_pin:optional, pure set(p) ENTER + finite go() rail).
engine: A POI map DIMS (opacity 1 -> dimTo 0.3 + scale 1 -> 1.04) to a dark backdrop as the section enters, while a serif announce headline + sub rise over it and a rail of location-beat cards staggers in; a finite rail advances by go()/next()/prev(). Pure set(p) scrub of the ENTER.
differs: Same map-dim + rail-advance mechanic + same pure set(p)/go(). BOTH platforms scroll-pin (S19g law): the map dims, the announce rises and the rail steps by SCROLL-PROGRESS read off .pin-wrap, on desktop AND mobile. Difference = LAYOUT (desktop wide / 2-col; mobile full-bleed single-col) + pin-length, NOT scroll-vs-time.

desktop.driver: scrollMap — set(p) = scroll progress across the pin span (stage pinned, wide/2-col); the tail of the scroll advances the finite rail via go().

mobile.driver: scrollMap — SAME set(p)+go() from scroll (stage pinned, full-bleed single-col); rail steps by scroll-progress, not a timer.

dimTo.what: map backdrop opacity at full reveal.

cardStagger.what: per-card stagger window of the rail reveal.

loop.what: rail wraps at the ends (else clamps).

revealDur.what: engine ENTER reveal duration (bypassed under manualDrive — wrapper scrubs).

slideDur.what: eased rail translateX duration per go().

railStart.what: scroll-progress point where the ENTER finishes and rail-advance begins.

railSteps.what: how many rail nudges over the scroll tail.

engine_patch: forceMotion (skip <=820px static-lock; wrapper drives set(p)+go() itself) + manualDrive (skip the engine's own ScrollTrigger so the wrapper owns the scroll driver; both additive, opt-in). See memory dual-platform-forcemotion + techniques-format-spec.
entry: MapDimCarouselDual.init(target, opts). Load engine.js THEN component.js. target = .mdc-stage > .mdc-map + .mdc-overlay ( .mdc-headline + .mdc-sub + .mdc-rail-wrap( .mdc-rail > .mdc-card x N ) + .mdc-nav ). Wrap in .pin-wrap for the pin (both platforms).
law: opacity + transform (translate/scale) only; GPU; NO mix-blend over the map; NO backdrop-filter over scroll; NO WebGL. reduced-motion -> resolved state (map dimmed, cards shown, rail at 0).
